sermon.title: Where Will You Be? 08/04/2019
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A message asking where you will be when God moves. God shows no partiality; He chose ordinary, moldable people like Peter and fearful Gideon. He cut Gideon’s army to 300 so the victory would be His. Don’t mix man’s words into God’s word; when God tests you, be part of the 300.
